label: politically controls
definition: Political group X controls or gains control of political body Y.
scope_notes: Includes: control/take-control/retain/regain/win-control; historical political control. Excludes: generic win/be-in alone; individual leadership office without party control; ordinary membership; sporting victory. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete control object or political-group identity.
